title: Getting started with alphaearth
text: AlphaEarth Foundations publishes annual, global satellite embeddings: 10m pixel, 64-dimensional vector (bands A00-A63) summarises year Earth Observation. tiles distributed Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs) Source Cooperative. alphaearth small, functional R Package find tiles need bring R datacube, local GeoTIFFs, VRTs. typical workflow four steps:

title: Getting started with alphaearth
text: index() downloads AlphaEarth spatial index (~500 MB) loads persistent local DuckDB database. download load happen single time; later calls reuse cache unless overwrite = TRUE.
code: alphaearth::index()

what: From a search to a datacube
title: Datacubes: sits & stars
text: as_cube() turns result search() analysis-ready datacube supported backend, selected : hood as_cube() never downloads pixels: tile writes small VRT files read embedding COG directly network (via /vsicurl/). heavy raster data touched actually process cube. backends share three arguments: output_dir: intermediate VRTs written, bands: embedding bands expose (A00–A63; 64 default), roi: optional crop applied every tile (object search() accepts).
code: library(alphaearth)  tiles <- alphaearth::search(   roi    = c(     xmin = -47.9,     ymin = -15.9,     xmax = -47.8,     ymax = -15.8   ),   start_date = 2021,   end_date   = 2021 )

title: Datacubes: sits & stars
text: sits, one single-band VRT written per requested band registered local sits cube. Extra arguments (e.g. multicores, progress) forwarded sits::sits_cube(). Note: version 2.0, sits provides native access alphaearth. Please, consider using operation.
code: cube <- alphaearth::as_cube(   x          = tiles,   to         = "sits",   output_dir = "cube_sits",   bands      = c("A00", "A01", "A02"),   multicores = 4 )  # the result is a regular sits cube, ready for the sits workflow class(cube)

title: Datacubes: sits & stars
text: stars, one multi-band VRT written per tile (embedding dimensions become band dimension) read stars::read_stars(). single tile returns bare stars object; several tiles return named list keyed tile id. default cube read lazily stars_proxy, meaning pixels read access . Pass proxy = FALSE pull values memory immediately, argument forwarded stars::read_stars().
code: cube <- alphaearth::as_cube(   x          = tiles,   to         = "stars",   output_dir = "cube_stars",   bands      = c("A00", "A01") ) # eager read (pixels loaded now) cube <- alphaearth::as_cube(   x      = tiles,   to     = "stars",   bands  = "A00",   proxy  = FALSE )

title: Downloading & virtual rasters
text: search result, alphaearth offers two file-based exporters share options return manifest: download(), download files local directory. as_vrt() writes VRT files point remote COGs stream data demand (download). functions accept bands, optional roi crop, layout, overwrite, progress, multicores, return tibble (invisible) one row per written file columns tile, year, band path. code block searches region, result used showcase function can used save AlphaEarth files:
code: library(alphaearth)  tiles <- alphaearth::search(   roi        = c(     xmin = -47.9,     ymin = -15.9,     xmax = -47.8,     ymax = -15.8   ),   start_date = 2020,   end_date   = 2020 )

title: Downloading & virtual rasters
text: layout argument controls embedding dimensions organised disk: "stack" (default), one multi-band file per tile, holding requested bands. "bands", one single-band file per embedding dimension. tile keeps native UTM CRS (reprojection). Files already exist reused unless overwrite = TRUE.
code: # one multi-band GeoTIFF per tile alphaearth::download(tiles, output_dir = "embeddings", layout = "stack")  # one file per band alphaearth::download(   x          = tiles,   output_dir = "embeddings",   layout     = "bands" )

what: Cropping to a region of interest
title: Downloading & virtual rasters
text: Pass roi crop every tile written. useful keep study area instead full tiles:
code: alphaearth::download(   x          = tiles,   output_dir = "embeddings",   roi        = c(     xmin = -47.88,     ymin = -15.88,     xmax = -47.85,     ymax = -15.85   ) )

title: Downloading & virtual rasters
text: Writing file dominated network reads files, downloads parallelise well. Set multicores 1 write several files (backed future / furrr).
code: alphaearth::download(   x          = tiles,   output_dir = "embeddings",   bands      = paste0("A", sprintf("%02d", 0:9)),   layout     = "bands",   multicores = 4 )

title: Downloading & virtual rasters
text: don’t need local copy, example prototype, keep disk usage low, hand small, portable file terra / stars, as_vrt() writes VRTs stream COGs. supports exact layout, roi, overwrite multicores options: VRT tiny XML file; reading fetches bytes actually request. cropped as_vrt() records crop window VRT, get small “view” onto cloud data without moving pixels.
code: # one multi-band VRT per tile, streaming from the remote COGs vrts <- alphaearth::as_vrt(tiles, output_dir = "embeddings")  # one VRT per band alphaearth::as_vrt(   tiles,   output_dir = "embeddings",   bands      = c("A00", "A01"),   layout     = "bands" )

what: Write AlphaEarth tiles as virtual rasters (VRT) — as_vrt
title: Write AlphaEarth tiles as virtual rasters (VRT) — as_vrt
text: Materialises selected tiles lightweight GDAL VRT files point remote COGs (via /vsicurl/). Two -disk formats supported VRTs: "stack": one multi-band VRT per tile, referencing every requested band (ae_<tile>_<year>.vrt); "bands": one single-band VRT per band (ae_<tile>_<band>_<year>.vrt). tile keeps native UTM CRS (reprojection). Existing files reused unless overwrite = TRUE.

title: Write AlphaEarth tiles as virtual rasters (VRT) — as_vrt
code: as_vrt(   x,   output_dir,   bands = NULL,   roi = NULL,   layout = c("stack", "bands"),   overwrite = FALSE,   progress = TRUE,   multicores = 1L )

title: Write AlphaEarth tiles as virtual rasters (VRT) — as_vrt
text: x sf object returned search(). output_dir Directory VRTs written (created needed). bands Character vector embedding bands reference, A00 A63 (defaults 64 bands). roi Optional region interest used crop tile. Defaults NULL (full tiles). layout One "stack" (one multi-band VRT per tile) "bands" (one VRT per band). overwrite Logical. Re-write files already exist. Defaults FALSE. progress Logical. Show progress bar. Defaults TRUE. multicores Integer. Number parallel workers used write files. Defaults 1 (sequential). Values 1 write tiles concurrently.

title: Write AlphaEarth tiles as virtual rasters (VRT) — as_vrt
text: tibble (invisible) one row per written file.

title: Write AlphaEarth tiles as virtual rasters (VRT) — as_vrt
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{   tiles <- alphaearth::search(     roi = my_roi,     start_date = "2020",     end_date   = "2020"   )    # one multi-band VRT per tile   vrts <- alphaearth::as_vrt(tiles, output_dir = "embeddings")    # one VRT per embedding dimension   vrts <- alphaearth::as_vrt(     x = tiles,     output_dir = "embeddings",     bands = c("A00", "A01"),     layout = "bands"   ) } # }
